key_highlights: Banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) led ASX 200 higher, snapping a three-day losing streak, but home loan applications fell 15% post-budget and mortgage stress hit 18-year highs
RBA rate path in focus: analysts warn a fourth hike looms amid sticky inflation, while Greg Jericho argues the economy 'limps along' and RBA should pause
House prices face potential 10% correction as rate hike risk mounts; Treasurer Chalmers under pressure on housing affordability
Mining exploration active: Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test, Dalaroo launches 12,000m African gold drill, Lindian signs 20-year rare earths offtake, True North expands Qld copper zone
Global: Fed's Waller signals rates may hold if inflation cools; oil prices climbing on Persian Gulf tanker incidents; Nvidia acquires Hugging Face for $12.9B
Australia's productivity rated 'bad to worse'; economy narrowly avoids recession; AUD under pressure from inflation concerns
Energy transition costs mounting; Beetaloo gas cartel scrutiny; TMK Energy gas rates surge; One Nation pushes to keep coal plant open
Healthcare: Ozempic maker in trouble, tablet alternatives emerging; hundreds of regional doctors strike over conditions

sectors.trend: Banks led ASX 200 higher but face structural headwinds: 15% drop in home loan applications, 18-year high mortgage stress, and potential 10% house price correction
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX may see NIM pressure from rate hikes but credit losses could rise if housing corrects. Dividend yield attractiveness intact but earnings growth at risk

sectors.trend: Active exploration pipeline: Macarthur WA iron ore bulk test cleared, Dalaroo 12,000m African gold drill, Lindian 20-year rare earths offtake, True North Qld copper expansion, PLC WA Murchison gold
sectors.implications: Positive for junior miners (MAC.AX, DAR.AX, LND.AX, TRN.AX, PLC.AX) and supports BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX on iron ore supply narrative. Rare earths offtake supports critical minerals theme

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel scrutiny; energy transition costs 'running off the rails'; One Nation pushes coal plant retention; Persian Gulf tanker incidents lift oil
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX, BHP.AX (energy) benefit from gas price strength. Coal (WDS.AX, LNC.AX) faces political pressure. Oil upside supports upstream E&P names

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble, tablet GLP-1 alternatives emerging; hundreds of regional doctors strike over poor conditions
sectors.implications: CSL.AX relatively insulated but GLP-1 competitive dynamics shift. Regional doctor strike pressures HIC.AX, IAG.AX (health insurance) and public hospital funding

sectors.trend: Costco service disruption; Campbell's dividend cut on sales/profit decline; grocery theft rising; small business uncertainty post-Covid
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (consumer exposure) face margin pressure. Defensive staples under pressure as consumer spending weakens amid mortgage stress

sectors.trend: Nvidia acquires Hugging Face for $12.9B; AI flywheel narrative strong; but few companies quantifying AI gains; data centre backlash growing
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX exposure but supports global tech sentiment. Australian tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from AI infrastructure demand. Caution on AI hype vs. realised returns

key_themes: RBA rate path uncertainty: fourth hike risk vs. economy 'limping along' creates two-way volatility
Housing correction risk: 10% price fall scenario, 18-year high mortgage stress, 15% loan application drop
Commodity exploration boom: iron ore, gold, copper, rare earths pipeline supports materials sector
Energy transition cost overruns and gas cartel scrutiny
Productivity deterioration: 'bad to worse' rating threatens long-term growth and wage sustainability
Global AI capex cycle continues (Nvidia/Hugging Face) but scepticism on ROI growing
Geopolitical risk: Persian Gulf tanker incidents, El Niño strongest in decades
AUD inflation risk: potential 'inflation rocket' could push AUD higher but hurt importers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike triggering housing correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and home-loan-heavy bank exposure; increase cash and short-duration bonds
Favour dividend-paying large caps (BHP.AX, CBA.AX) over growth; monitor GDP and employment data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical supply shock (Persian Gulf tankers, El Niño)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor oil and agricultural commodity prices; consider WDS.AX, SSO.AX as hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overruns and policy uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid over-exposure to unproven transition plays; favour established energy majors (WDS.AX, STO.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage stress and credit cycle deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NIM and credit loss provisions at CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX; reduce leverage

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD appreciation from inflation undermining export competitiveness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure for mining exporters; monitor RBA commentary and CPI data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight iron ore and gold exploration names on active pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Macarthur bulk test clearance, Dalaroo 12,000m drill, Lindian rare earths offtake signal strong exploration momentum; supports BHP/RIO/FMG supply narrative

opportunities.recommendation: Selective bank exposure for dividend yield, with tight credit-loss monitoring
opportunities.rationale: Banks led ASX higher but 15% loan drop and 18-year mortgage stress cap upside; CBA.AX and NAB.AX offer 6%+ yields with manageable risk

opportunities.recommendation: Energy majors on gas price strength and oil upside
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas rate surge, Persian Gulf tanker incidents lift oil; Beetaloo cartel scrutiny may tighten supply

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and housing-linked exposure ahead of potential 10% price correction
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth rate hike risk, 18-year mortgage stress, 15% loan application drop create downside risk for property sector

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Economy 'limping along', productivity 'bad to worse', near-recession risk; preserve capital for entry points

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge against AUD appreciation and commodity price volatility
defensive_moves.rationale: Inflation-driven AUD strength hurts exporters; El Niño and geopolitical risks create commodity swings

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound with elevated volatility. Banks provide support but housing/credit risks cap upside. RBA rate decision and CPI data are key swing factors. Expect 2-3% two-way moves around rate guidance. Materials and energy outperform on commodity strength.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from productivity deterioration, housing correction risk, and energy transition costs weigh on 6-12 month outlook. Mining exploration pipeline and AI infrastructure demand offer pockets of growth. A soft-landing scenario supports 3-5% ASX 200 upside by Q1 2027; recession scenario implies 10-15% drawdown.
